claim: A-048 (analytics walk on Tuzlu Rüzgar, 2026-10-03), ADR 0294: the /team Performance card prints its house median in the house's currency and 'per cover' (fmtMoneyExact), sets the member's own 'Sales per cover' beside it, prints every money figure through tm-format instead of a literal `$`, and labels wine sales over net sales 'Wine share of sales' (the founder, 2026-10-04: "Rename on the card (Recommended)"), never 'Wine attach', which /reports keeps for checks-with-wine over checks. Behaviour is pinned by PerformanceCard.test.tsx; this verify asserts the shape it protects.
verify: python3 -c "import sys; f=open('apps/web/src/pages/team/next/PerformanceCard.tsx').read(); ok=((chr(36)*2+'{') not in f) and ((chr(36)+'{m.') not in f) and (f.count('fmtMoneyExact(a.median, money)} per cover')==2) and ('k=\"Sales per cover\"' in f) and ('k=\"Wine share of sales\"' in f) and ('k=\"Wine attach\"' not in f) and (\"no other server here\" not in f); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

claim: ADR 0294 R1/M2/M3: performance.service.ts keeps the house median over the restaurant's 200 newest server_sales rows, this member's included (the founder, 2026-10-04: "House median (Recommended)"), counts only services that record covers with their sales (recordsPerCover), and sends analytic.benchmark.state computed / self-only / no-covers / unreadable. The median and band are computed only in the 'computed' state, so a member is never drawn against a median made of their own figures, and a failed read is never reported as 'no covers' (ADR 0067). Behaviour is pinned by performance.service.spec.ts.
verify: python3 -c "import sys; f=open('apps/api-gateway/src/team/performance.service.ts').read(); ok=('function recordsPerCover' in f) and ('.limit(200)' in f) and all(f.count(s)>=2 for s in ('\"computed\"','\"self-only\"','\"no-covers\"','\"unreadable\"')) and ('state === \"computed\"' in f) and ('benchmark: {' in f); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"
